high_level_description: This image depicts the interior of a modern café or coffee shop. The setting is bright and airy, with large windows allowing natural light to flood the space. The ceiling is white with recessed lighting fixtures, some of which are pendant lights hanging from the ceiling, adding a warm glow to the area. The café has a clean and minimalist design, with a long counter made of what appears to be polished concrete or a similar material. On the counter, there are various items including stacks of disposable cups, black containers, and a basket filled with utensils.
